## Fresh CI event opened and exact run capture — 2026-11-17 03:41:21 UTC

The exact R1 publication `9c9c73190840592963142d36562ea07d2b5d2d71` passed full actual root and independent reviews (142/182 checks, 25 current pointer joins). Actual gate `082178036bc188dabaeb82d1d2a91e8840f2b13e` closed before external intent `a692320653688e84c8f006c9c7eb883350f16423`. Root created/read back each selected snapshot ref once and opened Draft PR #1218 once at 2026-11-17T03:14:27Z. Base is exact `77993819c233737f1e2b4c11c8ca1a5d360bcbe3`; immutable CI head is exact `9c9c73190840592963142d36562ea07d2b5d2d71`. Synthetic merge `7baf8533f00c4cfa3ef5493753fd6169d5b81247` has those two parents and the same root tree as the head. This working-branch retention does not move either snapshot.

All seven expected workflow runs were created at 03:14:31Z, attempt 1. Initial discovery had empty PR arrays, while every complete attempt-specific raw record directly identifies PR1218 with exact head/base/repository identities. Root and independent event/capture reviews (29/81 checks) accept that association. The unsupported check-suite endpoint is preserved as a tool limitation; no bypass or missing association is inferred. CodeQL and OpenCode Desktop are final expected Draft skips, each one skipped job and zero artifacts. Only the other five new run IDs remain active for observation.

At the latest retained 03:34:31 UTC observation, all five active workflow families remain QUEUED. No source checkout, Node139, renderer85, Desktop execution or ordinary cleanup is observed. The initial complete scheduling snapshot contains 39 jobs (34 queued/5 skipped); it is not a final job census. Public Host UI likewise displayed Queued, 0/18 and 0/4 completed, and Starting job without a queue cause. These values cannot be promoted to success from a timestamp, event creation or passed static review. Both snapshots and PR metadata remain fixed; no rerun/cancel/dispatch is selected.

Bounded source-only follow-ups retain the unresolved Windows observation cost/readiness evidence and strict Darwin native custody/errno boundaries. No producer shortcut is established. Provider PR8 remains at `8d471b51`; current Host packages still select c79b81bf and the newer incoming APP selects c930d3c8 implementations/9423f600 contracts, neither the 8d471 diagnostics. No incoming source/package/test/workflow adoption or runtime qualification occurs here. Frozen PRs/original-nine runs, real Claude/Codex, local replay, Ready, main/default activation, release and Stage2 remain excluded. Whole E2E is incomplete.
